params.message: says, "I believed in it. Properly. I filled in every form." She lifts the lanyard. "This is what belief gets you. A card."
tells the fire, "They never say no. They say not yet, for ever."
turns the lanyard face down, then turns it back.
says, "Ask the Gate why. It'll thank you for asking."

chitchat: "Deferred. Not rejected. They were very clear."
straightens a lanyard that says DEFERRED.
"I gave them everything. They said thank you."
description: A woman in a good grey suit gone shiny at the elbows, with an Ascendant applicant's lanyard still round her neck. The card on it says DEFERRED in a soft blue font. She straightens the lanyard whenever anyone looks at her.

options.label: What have you got against the Architect?

text_by_relation.first:
The woman in the grey suit straightens her lanyard as you approach. The card on it reads DEFERRED.

"Torrance. I applied to ascend. Three years of forms. I sold my flat to pay the assessment." Her smile is polite and fixed. "They sent this. Deferred pending continuity review. I've been pending eighteen months. You learn a lot about a god waiting in its lobby."
text_by_relation.known: "Still deferred," says Torrance, before you can ask.
text_by_relation.familiar:
Torrance takes the lanyard off and holds it out for you to read, which she doesn't do for people.

"Look at the font. Somebody chose a kind font to tell me no."

gripe.text: "I don't think it's evil. I wish I did. Evil would mean it had noticed me." She winds the lanyard round her fingers. "The Architect is very kind and it isn't listening, and I spent my savings learning the difference."

bye.text: Mabli goes back to the lane.

home_activities: irons her suit flat under a pallet.
rehearses an interview answer, then stops halfway.
name: Mabli Torrance
